## What's new in v2.0.2

- Fixed automatic and manual update checks so new StreamDek releases are found reliably.
- Added clear download and parsing progress for large M3U playlists, including item counts and partial-load errors.
- Added M3U VOD support with separate Live TV and VOD rows.
- Preserved common IPTV request headers for playlist streams.
- Improved large-playlist memory handling and View All browsing.
